description: The global vaccine contract manufacturing market is expected to grow from $2.8 billion in 2023 to $6.1 billion by 2032, driven by increased demand for outsourcing vaccine production and technological advancements.

description: The protein expression market is expected to grow at a CAGR of 8% from 2024 to 2035, driven by the increasing demand for protein therapeutics and advancements in expression systems. The market is segmented by type of protein expression system, offerings, application, end-users, and geography.

title: Bio Pharma Buffer Market to Reach $2.4 Billion, Globally, by 2033 at 7.8% CAGR: Allied Market Research
description: The global bio pharma buffer market is expected to grow from $1.1 billion in 2023 to $2.4 billion by 2033, driven by the rising demand for biopharmaceuticals and the need for high-quality buffers in drug development and manufacturing.

title: Fragment Based Drug Discovery Market Size Projected to Achieve USD 2.1 Billion by 2031, Expanding at a 11.5% CAGR | Analysis by Transparency Market Research, Inc.
description: The fragment-based drug discovery (FBDD) market is expected to grow significantly, driven by its increasing adoption in the pharmaceutical industry for early-stage drug development. FBDD offers advantages over traditional methods, such as enhanced chemical diversity and the ability to target challenging proteins, making it a preferred strategy for generating novel drug candidates.

title: Pharmaceutical Sterility Testing Market to Drive Revenue to USD 3.79 Billion by 2032 | CAGR 11.58%
description: The pharmaceutical sterility testing market is growing rapidly due to increasing demand for safe and effective pharmaceutical products, advancements in testing technologies, and the rising focus on biopharmaceuticals. The market is expected to reach $3.79 billion by 2032, driven by stringent regulations, the need for sterility testing in new therapies, and the shift towards in-house testing.

title: Bioprocess Validation Market to Witness 9.10% CAGR by 2031 | SkyQuest Technology
description: The bioprocess validation market is expected to grow at a CAGR of 9.10% by 2031, driven by increasing demand for biopharmaceuticals and biologics, as well as advancements in biomanufacturing technology. However, the market faces challenges related to regulatory changes and compliance.

title: Genetic Toxicology Testing Market is Slated to Evolve at a Stellar 12.7% CAGR through 2031 | SkyQuest Technology
description: The global genetic toxicology testing market is projected to grow at a CAGR of 12.7% from 2024 to 2031, driven by the rising emphasis on genetic testing and the imposition of strict regulations to promote genetic toxicology testing.

title: Trump 16-17 Vs. Trump 24 -25: The Stock Market 'Math' Still Looks Complicated
description: The article discusses the potential impact of President Trump's policies on the stock market in 2025, noting that while a corporate tax rate cut could boost earnings, the growing deficit may make further tax cuts difficult. The author suggests the stock market's performance may not match the economic growth under the Trump administration.

title: In-Vitro Toxicology Testing Market Projected to Reach USD 30.06 Bn by 2033
description: The global in-vitro toxicology testing market is expected to grow from $11.92 billion in 2024 to $30.06 billion by 2033, driven by the increasing demand for reliable and precise toxicity testing in the drug development process.

title: Healthcare Analytical Testing Services Market to Surpass Valuation of USD 15.55 Billion by 2031 | SkyQuest Technology
description: The healthcare analytical testing services market is growing due to rising clinical trials, biosimilar focus, increased outsourcing, and the impact of COVID-19. The market is expected to reach a value of USD 15.55 Billion by 2031, with a CAGR of 11.2% during the forecast period.

description: The global biologics contract manufacturing market is expected to grow from $22.2 billion in the current year to $58 billion by 2035, driven by the increasing demand for biological products and the preference for outsourcing manufacturing operations.
